description.en: Patch-style file editing: one apply_patch tool for git/unified diff (default) and Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), with all-or-nothing application and sandbox-aware delete/move.
description.zh: 补丁风格文件编辑：单个 apply_patch 工具，接受 git/unified diff（默认）与 Codex apply_patch 语法（可选开启），全量验证后原子应用，删除/移动走沙箱感知 shell。
